meta.name: benchling-integration
meta.description: Benchling Python SDK and REST API integration for registry entities, inventory, ELN entries, workflows, Benchling Apps, and Data Warehouse queries. Use when automating lab data with benchling-sdk or the v2 API.

copy.tagline: 自动将实验室数据集成到 Benchling
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常在 Benchling 中手动操作数据
copy.tagline_en: Automate lab data integration with Benchling.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently manage Benchling data manually.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 可通过 Benchling Python SDK 或 REST API 操作实验室数据:创建和管理 DNA/RNA/蛋白等注册实体、库存样本与容器、电子实验记录(ELN)、工作流任务,还能查询数据仓库,并通过 AWS EventBridge 接收事件变更。
howto.when: 当用户要求用 benchling-sdk 或 v2 API 自动化实验室数据,或涉及管理 Benchling 中的序列、库存、实验记录、工作流、数据仓库查询及事件集成时,该技能会接管。

say.text: 把容器 cont_abc123 转移到盒子 box_xyz789 里。
查询数据仓库,统计本月所有工作流的任务数量。
say.note: 会运行 SQL 查询并汇总结果。

howto.what_en: After setup, Claude can use the Benchling Python SDK or REST API to manage registry entities (DNA, RNA, proteins), inventory samples/containers, ELN entries, workflow tasks, query the Data Warehouse, and receive events via AWS EventBridge.
howto.when_en: This skill activates when the user asks to automate lab data with benchling-sdk or the v2 API, or to manage Benchling sequences, inventory, ELN entries, workflows, data warehouse queries, or event integrations.

say_en.text: Create a DNA sequence named My Plasmid with bases ATCGATCG in folder fld_abc123 using Python.
say_en.note: Calls the SDK to create the DNA sequence and returns the result.

say_en.text: Transfer container cont_abc123 to box box_xyz789.
Query the data warehouse for the number of workflow tasks created this month.
say_en.note: Runs a SQL query and summarizes the results.
